summary: Frontend-only regression on /chat after ChatInputBox/MessageRow React.memo refactor and React.lazy Usage import. Tested on BOTH desktop (1920x800) AND iPhone-sized mobile (390x844). Fast-typing core regression worry (P0) is RESOLVED — 88 chars @ 10ms delay and 61 chars @ 12ms delay both round-trip byte-perfect in the textarea, no dropped characters, focus stays on chat-input during keystrokes. Login works, /chat renders, /usage lazy-loaded cleanly (rendered '$7.97' + 40 chats + 4 voice calls), VOICE ON/OFF toggle works, TEST VOICE button click is silent on console, 3 back-to-back sends produce 3 user messages and Wrench replies, no console errors, no page errors, ZERO 'Usage is not defined' / 'UsagePage is not defined' / any ReferenceError anywhere. ONE confirmed focus regression: clicking SEND button moves focus to the SEND button itself instead of keeping cursor in the textarea — PRD spec #6 not met for mouse-send (works correctly for keyboard Enter send).

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking the SEND button (data-testid="send-btn"), document.activeElement becomes the SEND button itself, NOT the chat-input textarea. Verified by typing immediately after click with keyboard.type() — characters land nowhere (chat-input value stays ''). PRD requirement #6 ("Chat input retains focus after sending — cursor still in box") is therefore NOT met for the mouse-click path. Sending via Enter inside the textarea DOES retain focus correctly (verified active el = chat-input after press('Enter')). Fix: call inputRef.current?.focus() at end of send() (or right after setInput('')).

The mic toggle button next to the textarea has NO data-testid (e.g. data-testid="mic-btn"). The mobile drawer-open icon also has no distinguishing testid which made the mic difficult to target programmatically. Recommend adding data-testid="mic-btn" (and "attach-btn") so iPhone-Safari lockup scenarios can be regression-tested reliably going forward.

action_items: (MEDIUM, PRD spec #6) In Chat.jsx send() function, refocus textarea after sending: add `setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0);` after `setInput('')` (or call onSend then refocus inside ChatInputBox). Currently the SEND button keeps focus on click, breaking the 'cursor still in box' flow.
(LOW, testability) Add data-testid="mic-btn" and data-testid="attach-btn" to the ChatInputBox icon buttons so the mic-doesn't-lock-input scenario is testable end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatInputBox React.memo refactor IS effective — fast-typing 88 characters at 10ms inter-key delay on mobile viewport produced byte-perfect output, focus stayed on chat-input, zero dropped chars. The original P0 regression worry is gone.

React.lazy(() => import('@/pages/Usage')) in App.js works — /usage renders the dollar/usage dashboard with no 'Usage is not defined' or 'UsagePage is not defined' ReferenceError in console. Lazy chunk loads under 3s with Suspense fallback.

send() in Chat.jsx does not refocus the textarea. PRD spec #6 explicitly requires cursor-stays-in-box behaviour. The fix is one line: inputRef.current?.focus() after setInput(''). Without it, mouse-send users have to click back into the box for each follow-up message.

Mic and attach icon buttons inside ChatInputBox lack data-testid attributes; the SEND button has data-testid="send-btn" which is good. For consistency and future regression coverage, add data-testid to the mic and attach buttons.

success_rate.frontend: 92% — 9/10 PRD checks pass. The only miss is PRD #6 (focus retention) on the mouse-send path; keyboard-send path works fine.

test_credentials: doc@drunderhood.com / wrench — login works on both desktop and mobile viewports.
seed_data_creation: Sent ~6 throwaway chat messages ('hi wrench', 'msg 1', 'msg 2', 'msg 3', 'quick test msg', 'focus test') to the doc/wrench session for typing/send verification. Safe to leave in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 regression (dropped characters under fast typing) is RESOLVED — re-verify only if Chat.jsx is touched again. The one remaining bug is focus-retention after SEND button click; once main agent adds inputRef.current?.focus() in send(), re-run a single Playwright check: click send-btn, immediately page.keyboard.type('x'), then assert chat-input.input_value() === 'x'. /usage works via lazy import; no need to regress that unless App.js routing changes. Test both 1920x800 desktop AND 390x844 mobile because the user runs iPhone Safari.
rca_of_the_issue: Fast-typing regression: ROOT CAUSE was that the message list and chat input were re-rendering on every keystroke and every AppContext per-second tick during a call. Fix shipped: (a) React.memo wrap MessageRow, (b) useMemo on reversedMessages, (c) extract ChatInputBox into its own React.memo'd component with stable props. Verification: type(88 chars, delay=10ms) on mobile 390x844 → input_value() length=88, match=True. PASS.   Focus-retention miss: ROOT CAUSE is send() in Chat.jsx (line 240-263) clears input via setInput('') but never refocuses inputRef. The SEND button is a <button>, so clicking it transfers document.activeElement off the textarea. Enter-key send works because keyboard.press('Enter') fires inside the already-focused textarea and doesn't move focus. MITIGATION: add inputRef.current?.focus() after setInput('') in send(), wrapped in setTimeout(...,0) to wait for React to commit the cleared value.
